# Sojutech, LLC

> Sojutech provides senior technical delivery and AI visibility work, also called generative engine optimization (GEO), for marketing agencies and works directly with businesses that need fractional technical leadership. Based in Western Massachusetts, serving clients across the United States and worldwide.

## What Sojutech does

- Technical delivery for marketing agencies: audits, remediation, and monthly technical work
- AI visibility, also called generative engine optimization (GEO): query baselines across AI assistants, structured data and entity work, 90-day re-measurement
- Technical search engine optimization (SEO) and Schema.org structured data
- Web performance and infrastructure: WordPress, Cloudflare, caching, hosting architecture
- Technical audits: Technical Website Audit from $3,000, AI Visibility Audit with the AI query baseline from $5,000; the audit fee credits toward a retainer started within 30 days
- Fractional technical leadership: advisory retainers from $3,000/month, embedded retainers from $5,500/month, larger portfolios custom
- Hosting and maintenance: $100 per month covers hosting and maintenance for up to 10 sites, then $10 per site. That includes hosting on our infrastructure or yours, core and plugin updates, daily backups, and uptime and security monitoring. Fixes and changes that need a person are handled as tickets. Retainer clients get the first 10 sites included.

## Facts

- Primary clients: marketing agencies, served through partnerships. Retainer pricing is the same for agencies and businesses. Work on your clients' sites is priced differently: audits at a partner rate, and projects at 15 percent off the quoted price with no minimums. Retainers include hosting and maintenance for up to 10 sites.
- Name: Sojutech, LLC.
